<p class=\"lead\">Uma frase de 7 palavra: A 7-word phrase becomes your key. You publish a link, and anyone can use it to encrypt a message that only you can open, with the phrase. Nothing is stored anywhere: everything happens on this page. Three modes, side by side: classic (X25519), post-quantum (ML-KEM-768) and the hybrid of the two (X-Wing).
<b>Não use para nada de valor</b>: Don’t use it for anything of value
<p>Não use para guardar senhas de bancos: Don’t use it for bank passwords, cryptocurrency wallet keys or anything of value. It is a demo, made with care, but without guarantees and without an independent audit. Lose the phrase and you lose the messages, forever.
<span>Nome, celular ou e-mail <small>ent: Name, phone or e-mail goes into the key computation and appears in every link
O identificador fica visível em todos os: The identifier is visible in every link. Use a name if you don’t want to expose a phone number or e-mail. To recreate the key later, you will need the phrase and this identifier, typed the same way.
<span><b>Anotei a frase num lugar seguro: I wrote the phrase down somewhere safe. Without it, nobody (not even LucentCrypto) can open your messages.
<span>Digite as 7 palavras <small>bastam: Type the 7 words the first 4 letters of each are enough; accents and capitals don’t matter
Gostaria de guardar a frase com mais seg: Want to keep the phrase more safely? Split it among people you trust with Lucent Secret. The words come from the Portuguese BIP-39 list, the same on both language versions, so a phrase works on either.

<h2>O que esta demonstração garante, e o: What this demo guarantees, and what it does not
<li><b>Só a frase abre.</b> Ninguém mais: • Only the phrase opens it. Nobody else reads the message, not even LucentCrypto, which never sees anything: there is no server.
<li><b>Computadores quânticos:</b> no mo: • Quantum computers: in classic mode, a future quantum computer could read today’s messages. Post-quantum mode is designed to resist. The hybrid stays secure as long as either of the two holds.
<li><b>A frase é tudo.</b> Quem tem o li: • The phrase is everything. Anyone with the public link can try to guess the phrase, forever and with unlimited attempts. That is why the page draws the phrase at random (77 bits) and each attempt costs a slow derivation (Argon2id). A phrase you made up yourself would not be secure.
<li><b>Remetente desconhecido.</b> Quem: • Unknown sender. The recipient doesn’t know who encrypted. There are no signatures.
<li><b>Links podem ser falsificados.</b>: • Links can be forged. Someone can publish a link in another person’s name. The defense is the fingerprint, checked another way.
<li><b>Não protege:</b> vírus no aparelh: • Does not protect: against malware on the device or someone watching the phrase being typed; files are not supported (text only, up to 2000 characters).
<p>Esta página é uma demonstração, feita: This page is a demo, made in good faith and with care. It is offered “as is”, without warranty of any kind, including of operation, security or fitness for a particular purpose. The authors and LucentCrypto accept no liability for any damage arising from its use. The code has not yet been independently audited.
